name: Realistic digital twin (Blender-built airframe, cockpit and engine)

reference.propeller: McCauley two-blade fixed pitch, 75 in (POH p.1-3)
reference.handbook: Cessna Model 172N POH, 1 July 1978 — page references in blender/c172/units.py, data/poh_references.json and node extras

status_vocabulary.measured: verified measurement from the identified aircraft (measurement record cited)
status_vocabulary.type_data: published type data, confirm against TCDS 3A12 / E-274
status_vocabulary.estimated: estimated from photographs / general arrangement; not manufacturer data

model.source: models/C172N_realistic.blend (editable, modifiers live, textures relative) built by blender/build.py
model.toolchain: Blender 4.5.15 LTS headless (scripts/get_blender.sh), Python 3 + numpy + Pillow for textures; blender/posmaps.py writes where each texel of the painted skins lies before the textures are painted
model.compression: KHR_draco_mesh_compression; textures 2048 px (high) and 1024 px (medium, low), the paint of the fuselage twice as fine (assets/textures); shade baked into the vertex colours (COLOR_0)
model.units_axes: metres; glTF +Y up, +Z forward, +X left wing (same as Phase 7)
model.geometry_status: overall envelope from POH Fig 1-1; airfoils, dihedral, gear track, tyre sizes type data; sections, windows, cowl, panel layout, engine accessories estimated

textures: all generated by blender/c172/textures.py and dials.py (original; no third-party images). The paint scheme and the markings are the model's own; no registration is painted on the model

viewer.stack: three.js r160 (vendored, MIT), ES modules, no build step
viewer.rendering: PBR lit by a sky drawn by a shader (PMREM), a concrete apron, shadow-mapped sun, clear coat on the paint, bloom and grading on the high and medium levels, GTAO and transmissive glass on the high level, ACES tone mapping
features: click select with bilingual info and documentation status
measured / POH / type-data / estimated confidence overlay
isolate / hide / restore per system and part
doors, flaps, ailerons, elevator, rudder, trim, nose-wheel steering
removable upper cowl, X-ray engine, crank-driven pistons/rods/valves, plug firing (1-3-2-4, POH plug map)
3D instruments driven by the Phase 7 simulation (14 needles, AI ball, DG card)
quality level selection (auto by device, user override)

tests.python: tests/test_profiles.py (profiles, units, wing area); repository tests cover measurement import, validation and deviation reports
tests.node: tests/sim.test.mjs, scenarios.test.mjs, kinematics.test.mjs (GLB ↔ kinematics ↔ POH plug map)
tests.glb: scripts/validate_glb.py (structure, extras, budgets); scripts/compare_builds.py (CI rebuild = committed)
tests.browser: tests/e2e.mjs (Playwright Chromium: load, interactions, engine start, cockpit, scenarios, RTL, phone width, 3 quality levels)

safety: Educational approximation. Not for flight, maintenance, manufacturing or training credit.
